notes.title: New Patch - v0.0.0.1 - 0.1.0.3
notes.content:
[h1]New Features[/h1]
[b]Partial Joystick Support[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31242460/a75f63816ab45856706ab1bf8bc218d3a956a7e6.png[/img]
[list]
    [*]Added partial joystick support to the game. 
    [*]This feature requires to be enabled from Settings -> Input -> Enable Joystick Controller. Our core features requires mouse click to be activated. We add partial mouse functionality to the joystick controller which is called "Joystick Click". Using this ability players can simulate mouse clicks by joystick, thats why we called this feature "partial". We will update the mobility of joystick usage in our future updates.
[/list]

notes.title: New Patch - v0.0.0.1 - 0.1.0.1
notes.content:
New Patch - v0.0.0.1 - 0.1.0.1

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31242460/0840d484601dee838d73a6fd244512309b18d2a2.png[/img]

The procedural island system is finally here with lots of improvements and fixes. Check out the new features trailer from the link below.

https://youtu.be/Ny-kTpwKuKU

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[b]Procedural generated island system[/b]
[list]
    [*]We have implemented our new procedural island system. There are 30 different generated islands. For each new created game, the system loads a random island. Also each 20th level the system teleports player to another random island.
[/list]
[b]Difficulty levels[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added 4 different difficulty levels. Easy, medium, hard and impossible. Each difficulty level increases the monster health rate. Also for multiplayer games, each player increases the difficulty level.
[/list]
[b]Random atmosphere system[/b]
[list]
    [*]The system creates a unique atmosphere for each island.
[/list]
[b]Ultimate portal system[/b]
[list]
    [*]This feature was already implemented in our core build. We have increased the rate of the event. The ultimate portals summons special kind of invaders which are not dropping any kind of resources. These portals are summoning continously and increases the rate of summoning speed in time. Players should hurry to destroy these types of portals as soon as possible.
[/list]
[b]Camera zoom in-out[/b]
[list]
    [*]By using mouse wheel players can zoom in or out for better viewport.
[/list]
[b]Invert mouse option[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added new inverting mouse option to the settings menu.
[/list]
[b]New Anti-Aliasing system[/b]
[list]
    [*]We added new anti-aliasing system to our camera. It can be adjusted from the settings menu.
[/list]
[b]Foliage quality settings[/b]
[list]
    [*]Our new generated islands have different types of foliage. We added some options which players can adjust for better performance on low spec PC's.
[/list]
[b]New translation: Japanese[/b]
[list]
    [*]Thanks to our community member "CURRY_DAYS" we managed to add japanese translation to our game.
[/list]
[b]Loading tips[/b]
[list]
    [*]We will provide some useful information on loading windows to help the players.
[/list]
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Fixed upgrade menu not working on certain camera angles.
    [*]Fixed shadow flicker issues.
[/list]
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Improved atmosphere performance.
    [*]Removed drone colliders.
    [*]Improved performance on post process effects.
    [*]Improved multiplayer lobby system.
    [*]Ambient occlusion visual improvements.
    [*]Increased water plane damage area.
    [*]Improved AI difficulty balance.
[/list]

notes.title: New Patch - Public Games & In-Game Chat - 0.0.0.1 - 0.0.8.4
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

Hello everyone, we have published some cool new features. You will be able to create public matches which everyone can join. We are allowing people to join on ongoing matches. Be careful after you join to a game, you might be spawning under a huge titan!

Also we have added a new chat window where players can communicate inside the game. Currently our chat allows to type maximum 35 characters at once. The reason is, currently we do not have any chat servers and every message is limited by some amount of character numbers. We will going to implement a new chat server and allow players to type more characters at once.

[b]New Features[/b]
    [u] Create public game[/u]
[list]
    [*]Players can create public games which will list on the server list. Use "Refresh" button to list public games. To play with friends, click on host from the friends list on the left side.
[/list]
[u] In-Game Chat[/u]
[list]
    [*]Added new chat window. Press "Enter" or click on the chat icon below the mini map.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31242460/a5077f621b223f615165e9ee94f9a534c0a2aa29.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
    [*]We have removed all the stone colliders because of tanks getting stuck.
    [*]Deleted high amount of unnecessary bush and stones to increase performance.
    [*]We have adressed and fixed a high performance issue about our weather system.
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Fixed localization problems on turret tooltips. All tooltip infos are now translated.
    [*]Fixed avatar resolution problem in the main menu.
    [*]Fixed font size problem on the general info window which can be opened by pressing "V".
[/list]

notes.title: Road Map
notes.content:
Only one day passed since our game is released and we already started to receive feedback from our players.

We have some major improvements which will be implemented in near future.

Here is what we are working on;

[list]
    [*] Procedural island generation.
    [*] Progressive level system.
    [*] New enemies.
    [*] New turrets.
    [*] In-game chat system.
    [*] Public game creation where everyone can join using the server list.
[/list]

We hope to hear more feedback and suggestions and looking forward to see how our game evolves.

Many thanks.

notes.title: DEFENDERS OF THE FALLEN ISLAND's steam community is now live!
notes.content:
After several months of hard work and dedication, we are pleased to announce our new FPS/TPS hybrid tower defense game. We are looking forward to hear what you think about our project.

[b] Our key features are;	[/b]
[list]
    [*]First Person & Third Person tower defense experience.
    [*]4 Player multiplayer Co-Op
    [*]Massive open world
    [*]Random portal spawners
    [*]Random event system
    [*]7 Different turrets
    [*]Drones
    [*]7 Types of enemies
    [*]Upgrade system
    [*]Vehicle turret system
    [*]Level system
    [*]Steam achievements
    [*]Checkpoint system
    [*]Skill system
    [*]Endless difficulty system
    [*]Dynamic weather system
[/list]

Our page is now live and please add us to your wishlist to receive notifications about new updates, discussions and announcements. Also do not forget to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/OWI_Development] Twitter	[/url].
